subject: Quick shuffle for tomorrow's sync
text: Hi there, I’m so sorry to throw a little wobble into the calendar, but I’m hoping you can swap tomorrow’s one-to-one to Thursday afternoon. My train home from the client workshop has been cancelled because of a signal fault near the depot, and I’m not likely to get back as planned. I’d still like to keep our conversation as relaxed as possible, so no rush at all. Just let me know if two or three o'clock works for you instead. If not, we can find a quieter slot later. Sorry again, and I’ll bring the updated roadmap notes either way. Thanks so much for being flexible with this unexpected shuffle, truly.
